## 순차 처리 경과
- polestar 컬럼 설명 미등록 — 컬럼 설명 없이 조회했습니다. 관리자 「DB 구조」 탭에서 컬럼 설명 등록이 필요합니다.
done.executed_sql:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' AND cc.name='Hostname' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "호스트명",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Cpus' AND s.definition_name='Utilization' AND s.avg_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.avg_val END)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 평균",
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Cpus' AND s.definition_name='Utilization' AND s.max_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.max_val END)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 최고",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Memory' AND s.definition_name='Utilization' AND s.avg_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.avg_val END)::numeric, 2) AS "메모리 평균"
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc ON cc.configuration_id = c.resource_conf_id
LEFT JOIN polestar.cmm_metric_stat_m s ON s.resource_id = c.id AND s.definition_name = 'Utilization' AND s.stat_date = '202605'
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Cpus', 'server.Memory', 'server.Server')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
LIMIT 10000;
